1:
Oh, it's grilling up nicely. Mmm, that smell's
making me hungry!
2:
Man, as expected from meat the President
got for us, it's all top-quality stuff.
3:
There's meat from all different cuts of
the cow.
5:
Here, eat up, Sohara. It's smothered in
sauce and really good!
6:
Thanks! Oh, I'll grill yours for you,
Tomo-chan. Which cut do you want?
11:
Fillet, hands down. I mean, you only get a
little bit of it from a single cow.
12: Fillet it is. Got it, Tomo-chan.
13:
It's low in fat, but tender and seriously
tasty. Whoops, don't overcook it!
15: It does look delicious. Here, enjoy.
16: Thanks, Sohara. Chomp, chomp, so good!
17: Yep, going with the fillet was the right call.
19: Hm? What's up, Sohara? You're staring.
20:
Oh, no, it's nothing. It just looks really
good.
21:
What, you want some? Then I'll give you one
bite. Here, say "aah."
23:
What's wrong, you don't want it? Then I'll
eat the whole thing.
24: W-Wait, Tomo-chan! I'll eat it, I'll eat it!
26:
(Wh-Why does she have to take a deep
breath every time?)
30:
(My heart was pounding so hard, I couldn't
even taste it, Tomo-chan...)
31: When it comes to meat, it's gotta be sirloin!
32: Sirloin's so yummy! I'm gonna grill some too!
34:
Yeah! On a person, it'd be right around the
waist. The waist...
35:
Nom nom, munch munch. Yummy! I'm gonna
have another one!
40:
...C-Come on, Tomo-chan. You said something
so weird out of nowhere, I dropped my
chopsticks.
41:
Heh, you can't fool these eyes. You've
clearly bulked up since the night before
we came to the beach!
42: No good! This is no good, Sohara.
44:
Your chest bulking up is fine by me. And a
slightly plump waist? I'd actually welcome
that!
45:
But! Your sirloin can't bulk up any more
than this! There's a limit to marbling!
46:
So, for the sake of your waist's future,
I'll eat this meat for you!
52:
Your lack of tact is nothing new,
Tomo-chan, but...
55: This time, isn't that... a little too cruel...?
58: Wait, Sohara! I-I was wrong! Forgive m...
59: I'm going to butcher you now, Tomo-chan.
61:
I really thought I was done for this time,
but somehow I escaped being butchered. I
am alive.
64:
I hereby request the boobs of the prime
Sohara cow!
65: Tomo-chan?! What are you doing, sto...!
66:
Uhyohyohyohyo! Come on, hand 'em over!
Out with 'em!
68:
Tomo-chan... No fooling around while we're
eating!
71:
After that, I got lectured while kneeling
formally. I don't think I'll ever forget how
hot that midsummer sand was.
